hooks.command: cmd=$(node -e "let d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));process.stdout.write((d.tool_input&&d.tool_input.command)||'')" 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cur=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$cur" = "dev" ] || ! git rev-parse --verify dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; git fetch origin dev --quiet 2>/dev/null; target=dev; if git rev-parse --verify origin/dev >/dev/null 2>&1; then target=origin/dev; fi; if git merge-base --is-ancestor "$target" HEAD 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'PreToolUse',permissionDecision:'deny',permissionDecisionReason:'La branche '+process.argv[2]+' n a pas encore integre '+process.argv[1]+'. Fais git fetch origin dev puis git merge dev (ou origin/dev), resous les conflits, commite, puis reessaie le push (voir CLAUDE.md, Workflow Git > Push).'}}))" "$target" "$cur"
hooks.statusMessage: Vérification que dev est mergée avant le push...

hooks.command: cur=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$cur" in worktree-*) new="${cur#worktree-}"; git branch -m "$new" 2>/dev/null && echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"Branche renommee $cur -> $new (convention NNNN-slug de CLAUDE.md)\"}";; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Vérification du nom de branche du worktree...

hooks.command: uncommitted=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'devlogs/'); if [ -n "$uncommitted" ]; then devlog_touched=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep 'devlogs/'); if [ -z "$devlog_touched" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"Stop\",\"additionalContext\":\"Rappel devlog : des changements non commites existent hors de devlogs/, et aucune entree de devlog n a ete ajoutee cette session. Avant de considerer le travail termine, ajoute une entree brute dans devlogs/<prochain-lundi>-draft.md (voir CLAUDE.md, section Devlog hebdomadaire).\"}}"; fi; fi
